summary.title: Impact Analysis: Add Reservation Flow Before Purchase
summary.overview: This change introduces a reservation system before purchase in UniMarket, affecting 12 files across 5 modules with medium-high risk level. The implementation requires careful state management and introduces breaking changes to the purchase API.
key_points: 12 files require modifications across backend, Android UI, and analytics
Primary impact on transaction lifecycle and listing state model
Breaking change: Purchase endpoint now requires reservation_id
Database migration required for new reservation tables
Test coverage must increase to 85% for reservation logic
Offline cache strategy needs updates for reservation state
Seller notification system requires new reservation events

affected_files.reasoning: Listing state model needs reservation status field and reservation count tracking
risk_factors: State machine complexity increases from 4 to 7 states

affected_files.reasoning: Transaction model needs reservation reference and new status transitions
risk_factors: Circular dependency risk with Reservation model

affected_files.reasoning: New Reservation model with expiration logic and state transitions
Purchase endpoint must validate reservation before processing payment
New REST endpoints for create, cancel, and extend reservation
Core business logic for reservation lifecycle management
Inventory locking mechanism must support soft reservations
Android purchase flow UI needs reservation step before checkout
risk_factors: Backward compatibility with older app versions

affected_files.reasoning: New Android activity for reservation management with countdown timer
risk_factors: Memory leak risk with countdown timer

affected_files.reasoning: Analytics tracking for reservation creation, expiration, and conversion
Cache invalidation strategy must handle reservation state changes
Integration tests must cover complete reservation to purchase flow
risk_factors: Flaky test risk with timing-dependent reservation expiration

factors.name: State Machine Complexity
factors.description: Adding reservation state increases state machine from 4 to 7 states, introducing complex transitions
factors.mitigation: Implement comprehensive state transition tests and state machine validation

factors.name: API Breaking Changes
factors.description: Purchase endpoint signature change affects all existing API consumers
factors.mitigation: Version API (v2), provide migration guide, maintain v1 with deprecation warnings

factors.name: Race Conditions
factors.description: Concurrent reservations on same listing can lead to overselling
factors.mitigation: Implement distributed locking with Redis, add database constraints

factors.name: Performance Degradation
factors.description: Additional database queries and cache operations may slow purchase flow
factors.mitigation: Add performance benchmarks, implement query optimization, use read replicas

factors.name: Data Migration Complexity
factors.description: New reservation table requires migration of historical transaction data
factors.mitigation: Create reversible migration, test with production data clone, run in maintenance window

factors.name: Mobile App Compatibility
factors.description: Older app versions will break without reservation support
factors.mitigation: Force update mechanism, graceful degradation for v1 API consumers

breaking_changes.description: POST /api/v1/purchase now requires reservation_id parameter in request body
breaking_changes.migration: Update all purchase API calls to first create reservation and include reservation_id

breaking_changes.description: Transaction table adds non-nullable reservation_id foreign key
breaking_changes.migration: Run database migration to add column and backfill existing transactions with null reservation_ids

breaking_changes.description: Purchase response now includes reservation object nested in response
breaking_changes.migration: Update client-side response parsers to handle new nested structure

behavior_changes.description: Purchase flow now validates reservation is active and not expired before processing payment
behavior_changes.impact: Direct purchases without reservation will fail with 400 error

behavior_changes.description: Purchase endpoint latency increases by ~50ms due to reservation validation
behavior_changes.impact: p99 latency may exceed 200ms threshold, monitoring alert may trigger

behavior_changes.description: Items in reservation state are excluded from search results and unavailable for other buyers
behavior_changes.impact: Effective inventory appears reduced during high reservation periods

behavior_changes.description: New notifications sent to sellers when reservations are created, expired, or converted
behavior_changes.impact: Increased notification volume, potential for notification fatigue

phases.name: Database Schema & Models
phases.description: Create reservation table, update listing and transaction models

phases.name: Core Reservation Service
phases.description: Implement reservation business logic with expiration handling

phases.name: API Layer
phases.description: Create REST endpoints for reservation management
checkpoints: All endpoints return correct status codes

phases.name: Android UI
phases.description: Implement reservation flow in Android app

implementation_plan.rollback_strategy: 1. Disable feature flag for reservation flow, 2. Database rollback migration, 3. Revert API changes with backwards compatibility
prerequisites: Redis cluster has available capacity for locking keys
Staging environment tested with production data
Mobile app force update mechanism ready

existing_tests_to_update.changes: Add reservation creation step before all purchase test cases
Update state machine tests to include reservation states
Update API tests to include reservation_id in request payload
Adjust latency thresholds to account for reservation validation

new_tests_needed.description: Complete reservation to purchase flow end-to-end
Concurrent reservation creation race condition tests
Mobile app reservation flow UI tests
